title: Tennis: Alex Eala downs Parry, advances to second round of Ningbo Open
summary: Filipina tennis ace Alex Eala is through to the second round of the 2026 Ningbo Open after a comprehensive 6-3, 6-1 win over Frenchwoman Diane Parry, Monday evening at the Yinzhou Tennis Center.
